subject: Roadmap clarity & runbook — next steps and action tracker
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@acmedata.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Roadmap clarity & runbook — next steps and action tracker

Team — thanks for the sync this morning. I wanted to capture the items we agreed we would follow up on and make sure we don’t lose momentum before QBR prep next week. Below is a compact runbook and the initial owner list.

High-level asks from Acme (from today's discovery/demo):
- Finalize the recommended model variant and quantization profile for their latency SLA (<=120ms p95).
- Confirm data retention & audit log details for their compliance team.
- Provide a canary rollout schedule and rollback criteria for Dedicated capacity.

Initial action tracker (owners + due dates):
1) Marissa — produce a short tech note (1 page) comparing 3 model variants with perf/cost tradeoffs. Due: 2027-06-25 EOD.
2) Laura — collate retention/audit answers and attach SOC2 evidence snippets. Due: 2027-06-24 noon.
3) Vivek — propose a canary rollout schedule (traffic %, metrics to watch, rollback thresholds). Due: 2027-06-25 EOD.
4) Rishi — align on commercial milestones and update the MAP (pricing + pilot cadence). Due: 2027-06-24 EOD.

Attachments: roadmap-2027-snapshot.xlsx (owner: me), acme-map-draft.pdf (initial commercial asks).

Please reply inline with any clarifications or flag if a due date needs to move. I’ll send a single consolidated follow-up to Acme after we have all inputs.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap clarity & runbook — next steps and action tracker

Rishi — quick clarifications inline.

On the retention/audit ask: Acme's security lead explicitly asked for:
- 7 years of audit log retention (meta + access logs) or exportable snapshots monthly.
- KMS integration (customer-managed keys) and a statement of delete behavior for KV caches.

I will pull the SOC2 sections that mention log retention and the KMS integrations. I can also draft a one-paragraph explanation of our audit export process that the procurement team can attach to the security questionnaire. That will be ready by 24th noon.

Question for Marissa: when you compare model variants, can you include the typical token distribution assumptions? Acme serves short queries (~20 tokens avg) but occasional long-context analysis (up to 2k). Helps pick the quant profile.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Manager, Redwood Console
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@acmedata.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap clarity & runbook — next steps and action tracker

Thanks — jumping on this. Quick notes:
- I’ll target the tech note to highlight throughput/latency at 20-token and 2k-token windows, plus cost per 1M tokens. I’ll include run results from the latest quantized build (Q4 quant profile) and an unquantized baseline.
- If we recommend an int8 path for the 20-token workloads, need ops sign-off on the autoscale headroom for bursts. Vivek — can you comment on burst capacity assumptions in your schedule?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Field Eng
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@acmedata.com>

Cc: procurement@acmedata.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 13:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap clarity & runbook — next steps and action tracker

Hi team — looping procurement here. Two quick clarifications so we can scope the SOW:
1) Pilot timing — we’re targeting a July 11 start if Redwood can commit to delivery of the pilot environment by July 9 (so we have a short soak window). Is that feasible?
2) MAP confirmation — please indicate whether the pricing PDF excludes cloud egress and if so we’ll add cloud networking as a separate line item.

If you prefer I can start a DocuSign envelope with a non-binding MOU to reserve the pilot slot once we get schedule confirmation.

Best,
Sarah
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@acmedata.com>, procurement@acmedata.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap clarity & runbook — next steps and action tracker

Team — thanks for the quick turn. Status update and consolidated next steps below (I’ll send these to Acme after any last comments by EOD Monday).

Status summary:
- Laura: audit/retention snippets — ON TRACK (deliverable due 2027-06-24 noon; I have the first draft, please finish embed links).
- Marissa: model tech note — ON TRACK (first pass attached; callouts added for token distributions).
- Vivek: canary schedule — DRAFT (requested ops confirmation on burst headroom).
- Commercial (me): MAP updated with pilot milestones; current draft notes cloud egress as separate; will attach final MAP by 2027-06-24 EOD.

Concrete asks to close this week:
- Vivek: confirm whether Dedicated pool can guarantee 6-week pilot availability starting 2027-07-09 and propose rollback metrics (p95 latency spike >40% or error rate >2%).
- Laura: embed the SOC2 export links directly into the security summary (so procurement can download).
- Marissa: finalize tech note and include a short recommended config we’d deploy for pilot.

Planned outreach: I will reply to Sarah & procurement Monday with a proposed pilot start of July 11 and attach the finalized MAP + tech note + audit summary. If procurement starts a DocuSign MOU today that’s fine — I’ll sign once the schedule is locked.
